This article is a stub. KDI was an American conglomerate with swimming-pool interests, including
Sylvan Pools, under whose name [Paragon Aquatics](paragon-aquatics.md) traded as KDI Paragon Inc.
from about 1970 to the late 1990s.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
